purpose: Connect safety-critical product review, adversarial mechanism mining, and bounded public prior-art research without collapsing their separate authority boundaries.
trigger: Use when a public or fully synthetic safety-critical product analysis must move from a consequential claim through a reproducible hard case into a technical mechanism candidate and bounded prior-art challenge.

stages.purpose: Establish the requirement-to-release-gate chain and reproduce a competent-baseline hard case.
entry_conditions: No validated safety-critical review record exists for the bounded consequential claim.
The task must establish whether a wrong-world consequence survives a competent baseline.
consumes: public or fully synthetic requirement, architecture, runtime, and test evidence

artifacts.purpose: Authoritative review workflow for the current stage.
Load only when emitting or checking the structured review record.
Execute deterministically; do not load validator source into normal agent context.
Use only when a concrete public-safe example is needed.
Maintainer conformance evidence, not runtime task context.

stages.purpose: Convert a reproduced hard case into a falsifiable reusable technical mechanism and commercial-value research candidate.
entry_conditions: A competent-baseline hard case is reproduced or otherwise evidenced strongly enough to preserve a bounded mechanism gap.
The task asks whether the gap supports a reusable technical mechanism candidate rather than only a product fix.
consumes: lat.safety-critical-review.v1 or equivalent public Product Attack Card
produces: retain, revise, reject, challenged, or prior-art-pending research state

artifacts.purpose: Authoritative bridge workflow for failure-to-mechanism reasoning.
Optional runtime-neutral Skill template for Agent-Skills-compatible downstream runtimes.
Load only when emitting or checking the innovation handoff.
Execute deterministic anti-premature-promotion checks without loading source into normal context.
Use only when an example of the handoff contract is needed.
Maintainer conformance evidence, not runtime task context.
Repository enforcement only; consuming agents should not load CI YAML as concept knowledge.

stages.purpose: Challenge the retained mechanism candidate against public prior art and neighboring technical mechanisms.
entry_conditions: The innovation handoff is valid and the candidate requires bounded public prior-art challenge.
Public-source coverage and research cutoff can be stated explicitly.
consumes: public patent and technical-source search scope
produces: retain, revise, or reject research candidate with strongest counterevidence and coverage gaps

artifacts.purpose: Authoritative public prior-art research workflow for this stage.
Optional portable research Skill template for compatible downstream runtimes.
Load only when producing or checking the public research receipt.

handoffs.condition: Advance only when the hard case survives a competent baseline and the mechanism gap is reproduced or explicitly evidenced.
Advance only when the mechanism survives the simpler-control kill test and requires bounded public prior-art challenge.

stop_conditions: bounded consequential claim cannot be established
hard case does not survive a competent baseline
simpler existing control kills the mechanism candidate
commercial value remains generic or unmeasurable
prior-art coverage is insufficient for the requested research state
human safety, release, legal, IP, or business authority is required
authority_boundary: This composition provides public workflow navigation only. It does not create a new module, certify safety or release, establish patentability or novelty, or grant private business, merge, deployment, or production authority.
